_about: The cadres Cadre ships with. Each is a whole cadre minus its folders: a machine adds those itself (pipeline.py project set <project> --dir <folder> --group <cadre>). On each daemon start, runnerlib/cadres.py seed_defaults adds any cadre listed here that this machine has never been given, once; archive one and it stays archived. Fields are a project record's (runnerlib/projects.py) without dirs, group, archived or context, plus kanban: true, which hands this machine's kanban board to the cadre if no cadre owns it yet. `nav` is the cadre's tabs and `agents` the agents its Agents tab lists. A cadre's skills are linked into every run in it (runnerlib/cadres.py skills_for), found in this checkout's .agents/skills or the runner's skills_source (code-walkthrough and the five learning skills: the ai-dev-skills repository); a skill added here later reaches a machine that already has the cadre, once.

agents.name: Tutor
agents.does: Runs study sessions: what is due for review first, one idea, questions graded next round. Every new study session is its run.

agents.name: Course builder
agents.does: Turns a whole subject into a topic map and modules, across many sessions.

agents.name: Card writer
agents.does: Writes and reframes review items: a question or problem of any shape, its kind, and a reference answer to grade against.
